edit_correctness.description: How well the generated image follows the edit instruction in the intermediate prompt.

garment_transfer_correctness.description: Accuracy of garment transfer from cloth image to model.

preservation.description: How well identity, pose, and background of the model image are preserved.

artifact_penalty.description: Degree of visible artifacts in the generated image. Higher means more artifacts.

notes.description: Brief evaluator notes explaining the scores.
